_comment: Model manifest. Sizes and SHA-256 digests marked hashVerified:true were computed by
downloading the exact URL below and hashing the bytes, not copied from a README.
Chat models are absent for now: they are hosted on huggingface.co, which the build
environment cannot reach, so their URLs and digests could not be verified. Adding them
with invented digests would fail every install, and without digests would give up
integrity checking on the largest downloads. See docs/MODELS.md.
The app works without them: recording, VAD, transcription, keyword tagging and folder
assignment all run. Only the on-device chat and local heavy tier stay unavailable, and

models.notes: Gates ASR so speech recognition only runs on actual speech. Tiny, and the single biggest battery saving in the pipeline. Without it the app falls back to an energy threshold.
English transcription. Archive contains encoder.int8.onnx, decoder.int8.onnx, joiner.int8.onnx and tokens.txt; the installer flattens them into models/asr/ and discards the bundled test audio.
